title: 第188章 那个救过你一次的女生，最后再救你一次
slug: 班级求生我是大客车内唯一男生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

李沐晴抓起契约书时，双马尾少女正蹲在她面前，歪着脑袋，小脑袋跟随着《SWeetDreamS》的鼓点轻轻点头。

狐狸面具眼洞里，那双粉色蝴蝶瞳孔滴溜溜地转着。

少女等着看这位姐姐犹豫的表情。

毕竟契约书的内容可不简单：

【契约内容：

1、被契约人遵循契约发起人的剧本，扮演好SS级副本的BOSS。

2、被契约人不得伤害、背叛契约发起人。

3、被契约人不得离开契约发起人设计的SS级副本，除非契约发起人死亡。

4、被契约人只能称呼契约发起人为‘妹妹’，语气必须温柔，必须亲切，必须带着爱！】

李沐晴拿着契约书，完全看都没看地面那瓶翠绿色的血清。

不是她不想注射血清，而是她把屿哥的安全看得比自己还重要。

李沐晴嘴唇张了张，嗓子干得发疼。

视野模糊的她，想直接问眼前的女生，自己要在哪里签字。

毕竟这契约书内容挺多的，如果全部认真看完，估计30秒早过了。

双马尾少女明显愣了一下，这才伸出右手食指，涂着粉色指甲的指尖，轻轻点了点契约书最底下的那一栏：

【契约发起人签名：夏灵灵】

【被契约人签名：】

夏灵灵看了眼左手的金色怀表，然后朝李沐晴晃了晃怀表，俏皮地开口：

“很好看的姐姐~，还有20秒哦~！”

“你还有时间看看内容，现在后悔...”

可夏灵灵话还没说完。

李沐晴就直接竖起右食指，一抹左手掌心的血液，完全不在意这一抹可能会撕扯到伤口。

她指尖沾着温热的鲜血，直接在契约书最后一栏，飞快写上了自己名字：

【被契约人签名：李沐晴】

字迹歪歪扭扭的。

李沐晴的名字笔画比较多，她刚签完‘李’字，指尖的鲜血没了。

李沐晴为了赶时间，直接将食指咬了一个大口子。

这才刷刷刷地快速签完自己的名字。

签名期间，她都没看契约书的内容，就这么义无反顾地签下了自己的名字。

就像高二那年一样，失控的大货车鸣笛直冲过来。

背着书包的李沐晴，也是这样义无反顾地将屿哥推开。

那个救过你一次的女生，如今最后再救你一次...

下一秒，这封契约书化作两股淡金色光芒，分别融入李沐晴和夏灵灵的胸前。

李沐晴脑海里浮现出契约书的内容。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

When Li Muqing grabbed the contract, the girl with twin ponytails was squatting in front of her, tilting her head, and her little head nodded gently along with the drumbeat of "SWeetDreamS".

In the eye holes of the fox mask, the pink butterfly pupils were spinning.

The girl waited to see the sister's hesitant expression.

After all, the content of the contract is not simple:

[Contract content:

1. The contractee should follow the script of the contract initiator and act as the BOSS of the SS-level dungeon.

2. The contractee shall not harm or betray the contract initiator.

3. The contractee is not allowed to leave the SS-level copy designed by the contract initiator, unless the contract initiator dies.

4. The contractee can only call the contract initiator "sister", and the tone must be gentle, kind, and with love!】

Li Muqing held the contract and didn't even look at the bottle of emerald green serum on the ground.

It's not that she doesn't want to inject the serum, but that she considers Brother Yu's safety more important than herself.

Li Muqing opened her lips and her throat was so dry that it hurt.

With her vision blurred, she wanted to ask the girl in front of her directly where she wanted to sign.

After all, this contract has a lot of content. If you read it all carefully, the 30 seconds will probably pass long ago.

The girl with twin ponytails was obviously stunned for a moment, then she stretched out her right index finger, with the fingertips painted with pink nails, and lightly tapped the bottom column of the contract:

[Signature of contract initiator: Xia Lingling]

[Signature of the contractee:]

Xia Lingling glanced at the golden pocket watch on her left hand, then shook the pocket watch towards Li Muqing and said playfully:

"You're so pretty, sister~, there's still 20 seconds left~!"

"You still have time to read the content, but now you regret it..."

But Xia Lingling hasn't finished speaking yet.

Li Muqing directly raised her right index finger and wiped the blood from the palm of her left hand, not caring that this wipe might tear the wound.

With warm blood on her fingertips, she quickly wrote her name directly on the last column of the contract:

[Signature of contractee: Li Muqing]

The handwriting is crooked.

Li Muqing's name had more strokes. She had just signed the word "李" when the blood on her fingertips disappeared.

In order to hurry up, Li Muqing bit her index finger into a big hole.

Then he quickly signed his name.

During the signing process, she didn't even read the contents of the contract, and just signed her name without hesitation.

Just like in my sophomore year of high school, an out-of-control truck drove straight towards me with its horn honking.

Li Muqing, who was carrying a schoolbag, pushed Brother Yu away without hesitation.

The girl who saved you once will save you again for the last time...

The next second, the contract turned into two pale golden rays of light and merged into the chests of Li Muqing and Xia Lingling respectively.

The contents of the contract emerged in Li Muqing's mind.
